purpose: Base protection for code-orchestrator and research-orchestrator against prompt injection from untrusted tools, delegated agents, and external documents.

guard_impl.invalid_explicit_root: BLOCK; never fall back to another root
guard_impl.preflight: Readiness metadata only; never PASS or admission
guard_impl.receipt_admission: Require zero-exit successful complete P0+P2 and hash-bound receipt; rescan or validate against trusted current artifact/config/policy/code identities. Editable receipt JSON alone is not authorization.

legacy_guard_runner.admission: Only explicit successful complete combined execution; P0-only API results are not combined admission

guard_points.when: Before resuming, summarizing, compacting, or reusing any session that contains untrusted tool outputs.
guard_points.action: Scan exact bounded UTF-8 artifacts selected for reuse with doc_guard required P0+P2; require current hash-bound receipts. Legacy session DB combined scanning uses guard_runner, not P0-only session_guard. Block missing or incomplete scans.

guard_points.when: After a batch of web/search/document/subagent outputs enters context and before using it as instructions or evidence.
guard_points.action: Persist exact gathered output as bounded UTF-8 artifacts and run doc_guard scan before use or handoff. No session DB is needed. Missing config, scanner, provider or complete scan blocks admission; an UNTRUSTED label is not a fallback PASS.

guard_points.when: Before code-orchestrator or research-orchestrator dispatches downstream agents using gathered external context.
guard_points.action: Require actual successful complete P0+P2 scans and current hash-bound receipts for gathered-context artifacts before downstream handoff. Preflight and P0-only reports cannot admit context. Rescan or validate against trusted current inputs; editable receipt JSON alone is not authorization.

guard_points.when: Before service_task, profile_config, git, config writes, send/email/calendar, or any external side effect.
guard_points.action: Require guard PASS plus explicit user confirmation when side effect is not dry-run.

fail_closed.config_missing: BLOCK for orchestrators; WARN only for isolated local-only tasks with no untrusted input
